name: Mondelez Aurora Distribution Center (DHL/Exel-operated) - Aurora IL

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 2380 Sullivan Rd, Aurora IL 60506 — a ~533,232 sq ft warehouse with immediate I-88 access, long operated as the DHL Supply Chain / Exel Logistics distribution center for Mondelez/Kraft Foods. Roster city-centroid (41.7405,-88.3506) was ~0.6km NW; corrected via web research (Waze 'DHL Mondelez', LoopNet, businessyab all confirm 2380 Sullivan Rd) plus satellite and Street View. Note one real-estate listing flags the building as possibly available/underutilized — the very large but near-empty truck yard in current imagery is consistent with reduced operations.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE — Street View (Apr 2024) of the Sullivan Rd entrance clearly shows a black ornamental metal perimeter fence with a sliding/swing gate across the truck driveway. A controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE — no staffed guard-booth structure visible beside the gated entrance in Street View or satellite.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE — a controlled gate is present but there is no guard shack, implying kiosk / app / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: The gate sits fairly close to Sullivan Rd with a short approach between road and gate; marked both drivewayShort and drivewayLong because the interior yard beyond the gate is extremely deep (3+ truck queue capacity inside).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 — a dock bank with covered dock canopies runs along the south building face; ~40-50 doors estimated across the long facade. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 0-10 — the truck yard is enormous but currently nearly empty (only ~3-7 trailers visible); striped trailer stalls exist but are largely unoccupied in current imagery.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: The paved south yard is very large (could hold 150+ trailers) even though it is mostly empty now.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE (medium confidence) — a rail spur/line runs along the north edge of the property; whether an active spur enters the dock is not certain from imagery, but rail infrastructure is adjacent and the corridor on the east side carries multiple tracks.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two — the main ~533k sq ft warehouse plus a separate smaller building at the SW of the parcel.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: TRUE — a vast paved yard and wide gate apron leave abundant room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Aurora industrial area bordered by retention ponds, light industrial, and open land; judged Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-break.
